blocks.text: After its premiere at the 2026 SXSW film festival, Vertical’s romantic comedy Love Language starring Chloë Grace Moretz, Anthony Ramos, Manny Jacinto , Isabel May , Lukas Gage and Billie Lourd has arrived in select theaters and on digital/VOD.

Written and directed by Joey Power, the film sees an aspiring author Lou (Moretz) — whose lucrative side hustle involves writing wedding vows for others like her friend (Lourd) — reconnect with her long-time crush Warren (Jacinto), only to learn that he is engaged to one of her new clients (May). Ramos portrays Dash, whom Lou meets at Lourd’s character’s wedding via another friend (Lukas Gage).
